title: Modern 2BR 5 min Broadway 2.5 Bath & 3-Head Shower
description:
Three showerheads. 2.5 baths. Two large bedrooms. Groups figure out fast why this place gets repeat bookings.

Five minutes from Broadway, Midtown, the Gulch, and Vanderbilt. Newly built — 65-inch TV, blazing-fast WiFi, and a kitchen stocked for real cooking.

Wake up comfortable, cook a real breakfast, and be on Broadway in five minutes.

This isn't a hotel workaround. It's a home built around the details.

Book it once. You'll see why guests come back.

The space
1 st Floor:
Upon entering, you’ll find an open kitchen outfitted with brand new appliances and everything you need to prepare homemade breakfast, lunch, or dinner for your group.

The kitchen opens up to a breakfast nook and spacious living room, which includes a super comfy couch, loungy chairs, and a huge 75-inch television for all your entertainment needs.

2nd Floor:
The master bedroom boasts a King-size bed and a huge walk-in bathroom complete with a 3- head shower—perfect for relaxing after a long day at work or night on the town.

Just down the hall, the gracious 1st guest bedroom has a queen bed and its own full bath.
